text:
Ava: Heads up — saw a cluster of WS/SSE reconnects at 2026-07-11T09:12Z. Console marks them as client_timeout but traces show a 204 keepalive immediately before a slab swap. Anyone seen this pattern? :confused:

rob: Yep. Edge logs show keepalive -> 204 then slab_id changes in <100ms. Clients treat 204 as terminal so resume fails and they open fresh sessions.

Lena: Sample sanitized logs:

`2026-07-11T09:12:01.102Z route=svc-prod slab=slab-21 session=zzz conn_status=204 keepalive=true`
`2026-07-11T09:12:01.184Z route=svc-prod slab=slab-30 resume_attempt=1 resume_ok=false reason="session_mismatch"`

ara: Root cause: slab-manager marks drain=true during rollout but keepalive path still responds with 204. Proposal: proxy emit header `X-Routing-State: transitioning` on keepalive when slab is draining and log `routing_transition=true slab_change_id=sha123`. That lets client libs treat the soft close as resume-friendly.

billing-bot: Billing spike detected: ~2.4k duplicate session events in 10m window. Opened INC-2026-778 (P3).

Ava: Console UX ask — when a reconnect alert fires include rollout metadata: canary_pct, draining_slabs, slab_change_id and handoff_hint (planned|unknown). Makes oncall triage faster.

rob: Also add `slab_id` and `route_version` to reconnect events and a `same_resume_within_ms` field so we can wire a dashboard that correlates reconnects -> slab swaps.

Lena: I'll add a `reconnect_by_routing_state` panel that pivots on `routing_transition` and `resume_ok`. We should surface the active rollout config in the alert payload.

ara: I'll open PR to add header + structured log fields and keep it under a backcompat toggle (env var). Will include slab_change_id. ETA ~30m.

devex-bot: note: update client guidance to treat `X-Routing-State: transitioning` as resume-friendly when present.

Ava: Billing mitigation: implement an opt-in metering grace window (default 600ms) where reconnections with same resume_id are not billed as new sessions. Gate by account flag. Sam/security can review.

billing-bot: Recorded for billing team: prototype grace-window 600ms opt-in.

rob: Quick action list: 1) @ara add header+logs PR, 2) @Lena dashboard+alert enrichment, 3) billing team prototype grace-window opt-in, 4) DevEx publish client guidance and rollout playbook update.

Ava: If we see renewed churn I'll drop canary to 0% and re-open the thread. Thanks.
